question: What is the name of the monument in New Delhi built to honour and remember the brave soldiers who sacrificed their lives for India? 🇮🇳
explanation: Great job! The National War Memorial (Rashtriya Samar Smarak) was built to pay homage to the courageous soldiers of the Indian Armed Forces who gave their lives protecting our country! 🎖️
hint: The name includes the words 'National' and 'War'.

question: Where is the National War Memorial located? 📍
explanation: Awesome! The National War Memorial is beautifully spread out over 40 acres near the iconic India Gate in New Delhi! 🏛️
hint: It is located in the capital city of India.

question: What does the word 'Homage' mean in the title of the chapter? 🙏
explanation: Excellent! 'Homage' means showing deep respect, honor, and gratitude, especially to those who have done something great for others! 💐
hint: When we bow our heads to say 'Thank You' to our heroes, we are paying this.

question: How is the story in Chapter 13 presented to the readers? 📝
explanation: Fantastic! The chapter is written in an epistolary format, which means it is an exchange of letters between two friends, Soumya and Ananda! ✉️
hint: It involves envelopes and stamps.

question: Who writes the first letter to share her amazing experience of the school trip? 👧
explanation: Spot on! Soumya writes a detailed letter to her friend Ananda to tell him all about her emotional visit to the memorial! 👧
hint: Her name starts with an 'S'.

question: How many concentric circles (Chakras) make up the design of the National War Memorial? ⭕
explanation: Brilliant! The memorial is designed in the shape of a Chakravyuha with four concentric circles, each having a special meaning! 🍀
hint: It is the number that comes after three.

question: What is the name of the innermost circle of the memorial? 🌟
explanation: Great job! The innermost circle is called the Amar Chakra, which means the 'Circle of Immortality'. 🕯️
hint: The word means 'Immortal' or 'Living forever'.

question: What tall structure stands right at the center of the Amar Chakra? 🗼
explanation: Awesome! An obelisk is a tall, four-sided, narrow tapering monument which stands proudly at the very center of the memorial! 🏛️
hint: It is a tall, pointed stone pillar.

question: What burns continuously at the base of the central obelisk? 🔥
explanation: Excellent! The Eternal Flame (Amar Jawan Jyoti) burns continuously to symbolize that the spirit of the fallen soldiers is immortal! 🕯️
hint: It is a fire that never goes out.

question: What does the Eternal Flame symbolize? 🕊️
options: The immortal spirit of the fallen soldiers ✨
answer: The immortal spirit of the fallen soldiers ✨
explanation: Fantastic! The flame reminds us that even though the soldiers have left this world, their brave spirits will live forever in our hearts! ✨
hint: It represents something that will never die.

question: Which circle is known as the 'Circle of Bravery'? ⚔️
explanation: Spot on! 'Veerta' translates to bravery. This circle honors the immense courage shown by our soldiers in battles! ⚔️
hint: The Hindi word for bravery starts with a 'V'.

question: What artwork is featured on the walls of the Veerta Chakra? 🖼️
explanation: Brilliant! The walls are adorned with six large bronze murals that beautifully depict famous battles fought by the Indian Armed Forces! 🛡️
hint: They are 3D artworks made of metal showing soldiers in action.

question: What is the third circle called, representing the 'Circle of Sacrifice'? 🪷
explanation: Great job! 'Tyag' means sacrifice. This circle is dedicated to the ultimate sacrifice made by the brave soldiers for their country! 🪷
hint: The Hindi word for sacrifice begins with 'T'.

question: What is engraved on the granite bricks of the Tyag Chakra? ✍️
explanation: Awesome! Each granite brick in this circle bears the name of a brave soldier who gave their life for the nation, ensuring they are never forgotten! 🎖️
hint: It tells us exactly who the heroes were.

question: What is the outermost circle of the National War Memorial called? 🌳
explanation: Excellent! The Rakshak Chakra is the outermost circle and it represents the 'Circle of Protection'. 🌳
hint: The Hindi word for protector starts with 'R'.

question: What makes up the Rakshak Chakra? 🌲
explanation: Fantastic! The Rakshak Chakra consists of beautifully planted rows of trees that circle the memorial! 🌳
hint: They are living plants that grow very tall and have green leaves.

question: What do the trees in the Rakshak Chakra symbolize? 🛡️
options: Soldiers standing guard to protect the citizens 💂
A place for birds to live 🐦
answer: Soldiers standing guard to protect the citizens 💂
explanation: Spot on! The trees represent our strong and alert soldiers standing tall to protect the country and its citizens day and night! 💂
hint: Think about what a protector does at a border.

question: What is the highest military decoration awarded for showing supreme bravery during wartime in India? 🎖️
explanation: Brilliant! The Param Vir Chakra (PVC) is India's highest military decoration, awarded to those who show the greatest courage and sacrifice! 🎖️
hint: The initials are P.V.C.

question: How many brave soldiers have been awarded the Param Vir Chakra to date? 🔢
explanation: Great job! A total of 21 incredibly brave soldiers have been awarded the Param Vir Chakra for their unmatched heroism! 💂
hint: It is the age at which a person officially becomes an adult in some countries, one more than 20.

question: What can you find at the 'Param Yodha Sthal' in the memorial? 🗿
options: Bronze busts of the 21 Param Vir Chakra awardees 🎖️
answer: Bronze busts of the 21 Param Vir Chakra awardees 🎖️
explanation: Awesome! The Param Yodha Sthal features beautiful bronze busts (statues of the head and shoulders) of all 21 PVC awardees! 🎖️
hint: They are statues that honor the bravest heroes.

question: What did Soumya feel when she read the names of the soldiers on the Tyag Chakra walls? ❤️
options: She felt immense gratitude and pride 🥹
answer: She felt immense gratitude and pride 🥹
explanation: Excellent! Seeing the names of the heroes made Soumya feel deeply grateful and proud of the sacrifices they made for our freedom! 🥹
hint: It is a feeling of saying 'thank you' from the bottom of your heart.

question: Why is it important to maintain silence while visiting the National War Memorial? 🤫
options: To avoid waking up the guards 😴
To show respect to the fallen heroes 🙏
answer: To show respect to the fallen heroes 🙏
explanation: Fantastic! Silence is a powerful way to show our deep respect and to peacefully remember the great sacrifices of our soldiers. 🙏
hint: It is a sign of honor and reverence.

question: What does the word 'Valour' mean when we talk about our soldiers? 🦁
options: Great courage in the face of danger 🦸
answer: Great courage in the face of danger 🦸
explanation: Spot on! Valour means showing exceptional bravery and courage, especially during scary or dangerous situations like war! 🦸
hint: It is a synonym for extreme bravery.

question: From above, what ancient battle formation does the layout of the National War Memorial look like? 🌀
explanation: Brilliant! The four concentric circles are designed to look like a 'Chakravyuha', an ancient Indian battle formation mentioned in the Mahabharata! 🎯
hint: It is a multi-layered defensive formation.

question: What feeling does the National War Memorial inspire in every Indian? 🇮🇳
explanation: Great job! The memorial fills every visitor's heart with deep patriotism, pride, and love for our great nation! 💖
hint: It is the feeling of loving and being proud of your country.

question: Who replies to Soumya's letter after reading her inspiring experience? ✉️
explanation: Awesome! Ananda writes back to Soumya, expressing how moved she was by the letter and sharing her own thoughts! 👧
hint: It is the person the first letter was addressed to.

question: What is the primary message that the chapter 'A Homage to Our Brave Soldiers' gives to students? 🎓
options: We must never forget the sacrifices of our armed forces 🫡
New Delhi is a big city 🏙️
School trips are for playing games 🎮
answer: We must never forget the sacrifices of our armed forces 🫡
explanation: Excellent! The core message is to always remember, honor, and respect the brave men and women who protect our freedom! 🫡
hint: It is about showing gratitude to our protectors.

question: Who led the students on their school excursion to the National War Memorial? 🏫
explanation: Fantastic! The teachers guided the students, explained the history, and helped them understand the deep meaning of the memorial! 👩‍🏫
hint: They are the people who teach you at school.

question: What does the word 'Sacrifice' mean in the context of our armed forces? ❤️‍🔥
options: Giving up their lives to protect the nation and its people 🛡️
answer: Giving up their lives to protect the nation and its people 🛡️
explanation: Spot on! The ultimate sacrifice means giving up one's own life so that the country and its citizens can live safely! 🛡️
hint: It is the greatest gift someone can give for their country.

question: In what color are the names of the soldiers engraved on the bricks of the Tyag Chakra? ✨
explanation: Brilliant! The names are beautifully engraved in golden letters on the granite bricks, making them shine brightly like their heroic deeds! 💛
hint: It is the color of precious gold.

question: What happens if a new soldier gets martyred? Is their name added to the memorial? 🎖️
options: Yes, new names are added to honor them ✅
answer: Yes, new names are added to honor them ✅
explanation: Great job! The memorial is a living tribute, so whenever a soldier makes the ultimate sacrifice, their name is respectfully added to the Tyag Chakra! ✅
hint: The memorial is designed to include all future heroes.

question: What do the four circles (Chakras) of the memorial encircle? 🏛️
options: The central obelisk and the Eternal Flame 🔥
answer: The central obelisk and the Eternal Flame 🔥
explanation: Awesome! The four chakras form perfectly around the tall central obelisk and the beautiful Eternal Flame! 🔥
hint: It is the tallest structure with a fire burning at its base.

question: Which of these words best describes the atmosphere at the National War Memorial? 🕊️
explanation: Excellent! The memorial is a place of deep respect, making the atmosphere very calm, peaceful, and highly inspiring! 🌸
hint: It is a quiet place that fills you with good thoughts.

question: Which word is a synonym for 'Tribute' as used in the chapter? 🎁
explanation: Fantastic! 'Homage' and 'Tribute' both mean an action or statement that shows deep respect and honor! 🙏
hint: It is part of the chapter's title.

question: What is the best way we can honor our soldiers in our daily lives? 🌟
options: By being good, responsible, and patriotic citizens 🤝
By throwing garbage on the road 🗑️
answer: By being good, responsible, and patriotic citizens 🤝
explanation: Spot on! We can honor their sacrifice by loving our country, doing our duties, and becoming responsible citizens! 🤝
hint: It involves doing the right thing for our society.

question: What is the meaning of the Sanskrit word 'Amar'? 🌟
explanation: Brilliant! 'Amar' translates to immortal, meaning someone or something that will never be forgotten and will live forever in our memories! ✨
hint: It means never dying.

question: Which of these is NOT one of the four Chakras at the National War Memorial? ❌
explanation: Great job! The four Chakras are Amar, Veerta, Tyag, and Rakshak. There is no 'Shanti Chakra' in the memorial's design! 🕊️
hint: Look for the word that means 'peace'.

question: How did Ananda feel after reading Soumya’s letter? 💌
options: She wanted to go to sleep 💤
She felt inspired to visit the memorial herself 🎒
answer: She felt inspired to visit the memorial herself 🎒
explanation: Awesome! Soumya's beautiful letter deeply moved Ananda, and she wrote back saying she really wants to visit the memorial too! 🎒
hint: She felt a strong desire to see the place.

question: What does a 'Mural' mean in the context of the Veerta Chakra? 🖼️
options: A large piece of artwork applied directly to a wall 🖌️
answer: A large piece of artwork applied directly to a wall 🖌️
explanation: Excellent! Murals are large, beautiful artworks crafted directly onto walls. In the memorial, bronze murals show brave battle scenes! 🖌️
hint: It is a form of wall art.

question: What is the main purpose of building a monument like the National War Memorial? 🏛️
options: To ensure the sacrifices of soldiers are forever remembered 🎖️
To use as a parking lot 🚗
answer: To ensure the sacrifices of soldiers are forever remembered 🎖️
explanation: Fantastic! Memorials are built so that future generations will always remember and honor the heroes who saved their nation! 🎖️
hint: It is a place built for memory and respect.

question: Who do the soldiers of the Indian Armed Forces protect? 🛡️
options: The borders of India and all its citizens 🇮🇳
answer: The borders of India and all its citizens 🇮🇳
explanation: Spot on! Our brave soldiers stand guard at the borders to protect the entire country and every single citizen living in it! 🇮🇳
hint: They protect everyone in the country.

question: What does the word 'Martyr' mean? 🕊️
options: Someone who suffers or sacrifices their life for their country 🎖️
answer: Someone who suffers or sacrifices their life for their country 🎖️
explanation: Brilliant! A martyr (Shaheed) is a highly respected hero who willingly gives up their life to protect their nation! 🎖️
hint: It is an English word for 'Shaheed'.

question: What values do we learn from the lives of the Param Vir Chakra awardees? 🌟
explanation: Great job! Their stories teach us to be incredibly brave, to put others before ourselves, and to lead with honor! 🦸‍♂️
hint: Look for the most positive and heroic qualities.

question: Which of these emotions is NOT associated with visiting the National War Memorial? ❌
explanation: Awesome! Visiting the memorial is a highly emotional and inspiring experience, filled with pride and gratitude, not boredom! 🥱
hint: Look for the negative emotion.

question: How did the teachers help the students during the visit? 👩‍🏫
options: They explained the deep meanings of the Chakras and the memorial's history 🎙️
answer: They explained the deep meanings of the Chakras and the memorial's history 🎙️
explanation: Excellent! The teachers acted as wonderful guides, making sure the students understood the importance and history of every part of the memorial! 🎙️
hint: They shared knowledge and information.

question: What acts as the 'Circle of Protection' wrapping around the entire memorial? 🌳
explanation: Fantastic! The Rakshak Chakra, filled with trees, wraps around the memorial just like soldiers wrapping around the country to protect it! 🛡️
hint: The name means 'protector'.

question: What is the English meaning of the word 'Rakshak'? 🛡️
explanation: Spot on! 'Rakshak' translates to Protector. That is why the outermost circle representing standing soldiers is called the Rakshak Chakra! 🛡️
hint: It means someone who keeps you safe.

question: Writing letters to friends is a great way to share experiences. What format of writing is this? ✉️
explanation: Brilliant! Since Soumya and Ananda are friends, their exchange is a perfect example of casual, informal letter writing! ✍️
hint: It is a casual letter written to someone you know well.

question: Why are the names of the soldiers engraved in golden letters? ✨
options: To signify the precious and golden value of their sacrifice 💛
Because it is the only color allowed 🎨
answer: To signify the precious and golden value of their sacrifice 💛
explanation: Great job! Golden letters represent honor, high value, and the precious nature of the ultimate sacrifice they made for us! 💛
hint: Gold represents something extremely precious and highly respected.

question: After reading Chapter 13, what promise should every student make to their country? 🇮🇳
options: To always be a true, responsible, and loving citizen of India 🤝
answer: To always be a true, responsible, and loving citizen of India 🤝
explanation: Awesome! The best way to say thank you to our soldiers is to promise that we will grow up to be responsible citizens who love and serve our country! 🤝
hint: It involves doing good deeds for your nation.
